meta.default_read_rule: Read this file by default before coding.
meta.archive_read_rule: Read the archive only when you need historical context, old diagnoses, rejected options, or detailed past decisions.

current_truth.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with semantic tokens
current_truth.auth_scope: Clerk only in apps/workspace, never in apps/web

architecture.shared_code_rule: reusable code belongs in packages, not duplicated in apps
architecture.asset_rule: shared brand assets must live in packages/brand; app public folders are only for app-specific assets
architecture.folder_documentation_rule: every manual source or shared-code folder must contain a local README.md explaining purpose, allowed contents, forbidden contents, and local rules
architecture.operational_protocol_rule: all non-trivial tasks must respect docs/OperationalProtocol.md before, during, and after code changes

package_roles.ui: shared design system and reusable ui
package_roles.db: prisma schema, prisma config, database client
package_roles.utils: shared pure utilities and reusable hooks

css_architecture.summary: Tailwind v4 CSS-first config with tokens and base styles centralized in packages/ui.
rules: packages/ui/styles/tokens.css is the single source of truth for design tokens
packages/ui/styles/base.css contains shared base styles and must stay wrapped in @layer base
app globals.css files must stay minimal and app-specific
never use @theme static because CSS vars must be emitted to :root
@source paths are relative to the CSS file itself
css_architecture.transpile_packages_rule: every app importing a @qoovex/* TypeScript package must list it in transpilePackages in next.config.ts

auth_architecture.middleware_pattern: clerkMiddleware + createRouteMatcher with public auth routes and webhook allowlist
auth_architecture.marketing_link_rule: apps/web must link to workspace auth pages with absolute workspace-domain URLs
auth_architecture.production_status: local auth works; production auth still blocked by Clerk custom frontend domain SSL/TLS issue

package_rules.react_peer_dependency_rule: packages using React hooks must declare react as peerDependency and devDependency
package_rules.package_entry_rule: public package APIs should stay curated and pass through index.ts when appropriate

rules: never hardcode token equivalents when a semantic token exists
never add hover to non-interactive elements
never use inline SVG for icons
shared brand assets must come from the shared brand source of truth

work_plan_rules: joining other users work plans is always free and unlimited
limits apply only to plan creation and member count per plan
only the plan creator can create tasks
task completion sends a notification to the creator
tasks can be free text or linked to a recipe snapshot, including private recipes
recipe snapshots on tasks must be immutable

do_not_break: single source of truth for shared brand assets
Clerk must never be added to apps/web
apps importing @qoovex/* packages must keep transpilePackages aligned

current_state.auth: partially stabilized locally; production still incomplete because of Clerk custom frontend domain issue
current_state.quality_gates: active via pnpm check: repo guard, eslint, type-check, app builds, lighthouse audits, and CI workflow

next_focus: activate and test production Clerk user.created webhook
complete end-to-end user bootstrap in database
then expand to menus, allergens, nutrition, shopping list, explore, and work plan

repo_guard: no inline svg in source components
